signals.title: 颜值、配置、实用度全面升级，改款诚意满满｜无极SR250GT二代静态解析
signals.summary: 无极SR250GT二代是无极针对初代车型的使用短板与用户反馈，进行了全方位迭代升级的产品。升级并没有只局限于表面化调整，而是聚焦外观质感、日常养护、储物续航、实用配置等多角度的核心用车场景，做出针对性优化。 无极SR250GT二代同时也延续双版本配置布局，兼顾不同用户的购车预算与骑行需求。普通版与Pro版两个版本价差2000元，配置定位差异清晰。本篇将从外观设计、细节配置、储物续航、版本差异等维度，全面解析该车的静态产品力。 相较于初代车型，无极SR250GT二代在外观细节上完成了多项精细化优化，整体视觉质感与实用属性同步提升。 车头部分改动最为核心，原厂四颗矩阵透镜大灯更换为双透镜大灯组，造型简约精致，但是并不是灯减少了灯光就变弱了，它的灯光亮度反而是提升至65000坎德拉了；车身侧边日行灯由平缓的J字形灯带，升级为立体折叠式T字形灯带，线条更利落、辨识度更高；转向灯也升级为一体式灯带结构，让整个车头的层次感与精致度得到明显提升。 风挡依旧采用实用性更强的两段式手动可调结构，在结构不变的前提下完成造型优化，由平直样式改为上扬收窄造型，整体高度和角度都有很大的提升，对小编的身高来说，这个风挡可以很好的缓解风阻压迫感，提升巡航舒适性。 仪表部分同步完成升级，配备7英寸高清彩色液晶仪表，取消多余的外围装饰包围，整体界面简洁大气，行车数据显示清晰，强光环境下也能保证良好的可视效果。 来到车身侧面，重点的发动机进行了外壳重新设计，线条更具运动气息。但最具实用性的升级还是发动机左侧新增透明机油观察窗，不需要拆卸车身部件，车辆熄火静置后，就可以直观观察机油液位与油品清澈度，极大简化了日常自检与保养流程，降低车辆养护门槛。 作为主打通勤、摩旅双场景的休旅踏板，无极SR250GT二代的储物表现也十分不错。首先前置储物盒增设防滑抓握卡槽，开合操作更便捷；右侧储物盒取消内部手机隔断，拓展了整体储物空间，可容纳更多随身物品； 左侧储物盒标配USB充电接口，还有一个很实用的升级是储物盒盖子上的专属导线孔。哇，这个点真的很戳中小编，不知道有没有车友跟我一样，有过因为充电硬关储物盒把充电线夹坏掉，或者为了避免充电线坏掉直接把手机放储物盒里导致看不到导航画面走错路，这真的就是一个很小很小的设计，需要的成本也很低，但真的很少有车考虑到这个点，所以就这点来说，无极的赞必须点了。 针对龙骨踏板前置储物短板，该车原厂配备隐藏式小挂钩，可悬挂箱包、水杯等不规则物品，补齐了日常代步的储物痛点，细节设计十分贴心。 储物与续航的实用性升级，是本次改款的核心亮点之一。座桶储物空间延续现款实用表现，常规状态下可容纳一顶全盔，护具、雨衣、维修工具等出行装备均可妥善收纳，满足短途摩旅储物需求。 在续航方面SR250GT二代的油箱容积升级到了15L，相比老款提升1L，配合优化后的动力调校与燃油经济性，整车续航里程也会得到有效提升，无论是城市日常通勤，还是近郊短途摩旅，都拥有更稳定的续航保障。 其他配置方面，普通版与Pro版的核心动力参数、基础车身配置保持一致，两个版本2000元的差价主要集中在舒适化、智能化进阶配置上。Pro版额外配备加热手把、加热坐垫、气囊减震、TFT投屏仪表、原厂1080P行车记录仪以及胎压监测功能。 对于仅用于城市通勤的用户，普通版足以满足日常需求；如果有高频短途摩旅需求、追求全场景骑行舒适度，Pro版的进阶配置具备更高的性价比。 整体来看，无极SR250GT二代在静态层面的升级全面也务实，外观质感、实用细节、养护便捷性、储物续航都有优化。扎实的静态硬件基础，就是车友选车是否有动力去试驾选择的前提，那么下一篇我们再来聊这辆车的操控动力等多方面的动态表现。

signals.title: 缤森电摩大爆料！双子星车型体验不同骑行
signals.summary: 外观大胆创新，能把复古与电动相结合，还能把电摩做出运动感的品牌，就是最新发布的新能源电摩品牌——缤森 鑫源集团旗下的智能轻出行新品牌缤森，在这次发布会上正式和大家见面了，虽说是新品牌，但背后靠着鑫源多年造摩托的底子，在这次发布会上直接一口气亮出一大堆车型，通勤踏板、运动电摩、硬核越野全都安排上，产品线铺得很全。而整场发布会最抓眼球的，当属缤森C5、缤森S5这一对双子星踏板。 缤森C5和缤森S5出自同一套技术底盘：森盾架构车架、高配ADAS辅助驾驶系统、双通道ABS+TCS、车规级芯片这些硬核配置两台车全都配齐。官方数据显示，森盾车架强度比同级高出60%，底子够扎实，而这套ADAS靠双摄像头加上自研算法，可以做到行车监测、碰撞预警，多一层主动安全防护。硬件配置几乎一样，但两台车走的路子完全不一样，这也是我觉得缤森这套思路最有意思的地方。 现在市面上不少复古电摩，说白了就是换个复古外壳，内里还是一台普通代步车。缤森C5不一样，复古不是它的外衣，从外观设计、骑行坐姿再到动力调校，整套逻辑都围着休闲复古来做。意式轻奢复古的造型，圆形透镜大灯搭配一体式流水日行灯，再加上可以自定义的车身氛围灯，不会老气沉闷，颜值很出片，打卡拍照自带氛围感。 动力方面，缤森C5本来就不是为了猛加速、激烈压弯而生的，人机设定、动力调校，全都偏向城市休闲骑行。骑行三角舒展，平踏空间很宽裕，座桶空间还能放下一顶全盔，不管是上下班通勤，还是周末在城里兜风、短途漫游，出行都十分方便。动力调校顺滑线性，加速体感对标125cc燃油踏板，没有很多电摩一拧油门猛地窜出去的突兀感。选它的车友，骑行不只是从A点赶到B点，更是享受在路上的松弛感。它是为喜欢颜值、慢慢骑车、享受氛围感的人准备的，复古不是营销噱头，整台车的调校都在服务这份悠闲的骑行体验。 如果缤C5主打慢悠悠、氛围感拉满的复古生活感，那缤森S5就是为喜欢操控、看重智能的骑手准备的，兼顾日常通勤和跑山玩乐。GT运动风格的外观，大量锋利的折面线条，一眼就能看出它的运动属性。它和缤森C5最大的差别，就在底盘动态和整套智能系统上。 同样是森盾高刚性车架，缤森S5的底盘调校明显更运动，转向响应更快、虚位更小，弯道支撑性很足，跑山压弯、连续变道的时候信心很足。智能这块也是它的亮点，全车支持OTA升级，靠着车规级硬件和一堆车身传感器，车子的功能不会出厂就定型，后续还能持续更新，这一点比很多普通踏板电摩要贴心。它的骑行三角也经过优化，不是一味做战斗坐姿，工作日通勤不累，周末约上朋友进山压弯也能hold住，一台车两种玩法。 简单来说，缤森C5看的是氛围感和休闲骑行体验，缤森S5赢在底盘操控，还有可以持续进化的智能系统。同平台同源硬件，却做成两台定位完全不同的车。缤森没有想着做一台“万金油”车型，指望讨好所有骑手，而是把大家的需求拆开，针对性给到不同的选择。 现在电摩赛道卷得厉害，很多新品的思路就是往车上堆大功率、堆花哨配置，想一台车通吃所有人。缤森走了一条不一样的路：共用一套成熟技术底座，把产品定位分得清清楚楚。它不想单纯做燃油摩托的平替，而是拿造摩托车的标准去做电摩。配置只是基础，最终要落到咱们骑车人真实的感受上。喜欢复古兜风、慢慢享受旅途，就选松弛舒服的缤森C5；爱跑山、追求操控，想要智能系统持续更新，缤森S5就很合适。 这场发布会除了缤森C5、缤森S5两台重磅踏板，缤森还展出了越野等多款车型，完整的产品矩阵已经浮出水面，城市代步、运动玩乐、硬核越野全都覆盖。同时工厂、研发、海内外市场规划也一并放出，看得出来，这不只是为了炒两台网红车的短期营销，而是一套长期布局。 当同行还在死磕纸面参数、比拼配置清单的时候，缤森已经把竞争从“堆硬件”转向了“骑起来怎么样”。同样一套硬核技术，读懂不同骑手想要什么，做出差异化的骑行感受，或许就是它入局电摩市场最核心的底气。 先见未来，硬核态度｜猎变蓄势2026 重庆摩博会，全新 350cc 硬派大踏板来了！

signals.title: Triumph unveils new Tiger 1200: four versions, 158 hp engine
signals.summary: Triumph has revamped the Tiger 1200 , the British manufacturer’s maxi-adventure bike, with updates to the engine, suspension and electronics. The range comprises four versions: GT Pro, Rally Pro, GT Explorer and Rally Explorer. The 1,200 cc T-Plane three-cylinder engine now delivers 158 CV at 9,250 rpm, eight more than the previous model. The updates also affect power delivery at low revs, the six-speed gearbox and the cardan shaft final drive. Among the new features, the Showa EERA Heightflex semi-active suspension stands out, automatically lowering the seat by 30 mm when the bike comes to a halt, making it easier to put your feet on the ground. The Bosch ARAS radar system is also introduced, featuring front and rear driver assistance systems, alongside a 7-inch TFT display with wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. All versions feature 19-inch front and 17-inch rear wheels , with alloy rims on the GT models and spoked rims on the Rally models. The fuel tanks hold 20 litres on the Pro models and 30 litres on the Explorer models. The new Triumph Tiger 1200 is now available to order. signals.title: LS2 Ranger: the new carbon-fibre modular helmet focuses on versatility
signals.summary: LS2 is a Spanish brand specialising in the design and manufacture of motorcycling helmets. Its range caters to a variety of needs, from urban commuting to off-road riding. For the 2027 Collection, the brand is revamping its range with four new helmets , introducing technical upgrades and new customisation options. Among the key new additions is the Ranger , a new premium-range modular helmet featuring a 90°-opening chin guard and a shell available in 9K carbon or Forged Carbon. The 3-in-1 configuration allows it to be used in an adventure version with the upper visor fitted, in a touring configuration with the visor removed, or with the chin guard open. The modular range also welcomes the Valiant Gear , an evolution of one of LS2’s most iconic models, crafted from KPA and fitted with a new ratchet-style opening system. On the adventure front, the Explorer EVO and Explorer EVO Carbon make their debut, both featuring updates to ventilation, visor management and compatibility with the brand’s intercom systems. The Carbon version features a 6K carbon or Forged Carbon shell, whilst the standard version is made from HPFC. The range is rounded off by 62 new graphic designs across 19 models already in the catalogue. signals.title: Kawasaki KX327 and KX327X: new fuel-injected two-stroke
signals.summary: Kawasaki is returning to the two-stroke off-road segment with two brand-new models for motocross and enduro, equipped with an electronically fuel-injected single-cylinder engine. For 2027, Kawasaki is expanding its off-road lineup with the KX327 and the KX327X, two models sharing a new two-stroke single-cylinder engine featuring dual electronic fuel injection. The system automatically compensates for altitude and weather changes, while a primary balancer shaft helps keep vibrations in check. Both models feature electric start, handlebar-mounted map selection, and an aluminum perimeter frame. The KX327, designed for motocross , combines a five-speed transmission with a 19-inch rear wheel. The KX327X, intended for cross-country and enduro , features a six-speed gearbox, a short first gear, an 18-inch rear wheel, and adjustable KYB suspension. Both are equipped with Renthal and Excel components, while the X version offers expanded customization options through Ergo-Fit adjustments and map management via the Rideology the App KX2. signals.title: SHAD’s Terra range now equips the BMW R 1300 GS
signals.summary: In the motorbike touring accessories segment, Shad offers solutions ranging from luggage carrying systems to equipment for touring motorbikes. The Terra range is now expanding its collection of products, complementing its luggage solutions with a new line dedicated to motorbike protection. The first application is for the BMW R 1300 GS , for which two configurations are available. The Upper Protectors safeguard the bodywork, radiator and fuel tank, whilst the Lower Crash Bars are designed to protect the engine, crankcase and exhaust manifolds. The latter incorporate nylon and silicone sliders to cushion impacts in the event of a fall. Made from AISI 304 stainless steel, with tubes 25 mm in diameter and 2 mm thick, the protection kits are available in electropolished silver and powder-coated black finishes. Installation utilises the frame’s original mounting points, requiring no modifications to the motorbike. The Upper bars can also support additional panniers, such as the Shad TR08. signals.title: Stop&Up, the electro-hydraulic stand that lifts and stabilises the vehicle
signals.summary: Stampaggio Plastica Affini operates in the plastic moulding sector and is presenting a patented solution at EICMA 2026 that reimagines one of the motorbike and scooter's most traditional components. It is called Stop&Up and is an automatic electro-hydraulic stand , designed by DDesing Lab. The system allows the vehicle to be raised and positioned vertically without any physical effort , whilst also adapting to uneven surfaces and sloping ground. The greater distance between the support points compared to a conventional stand widens the support base, improving stability and making it easier to park in the tightest of spaces. Activation is subject to specific safety conditions: with the engine running, the vehicle must be upright, with the brake applied and the wheels completely stationary. A mechanical lock is also provided for prolonged parking. In the event of a fault or power cut, the device can be disconnected from the automatic system and used manually like a traditional stand. The modular design will allow Stop&Up to be adapted to vehicles of different sizes and categories, whilst the tapered cover is designed to blend in with the motorcycle’s lines. signals.title: Zontes introduces ride-by-wire throttle on the ZT703-RR
signals.summary: The ZT703-RR by Zontes gets an update focusing on electronics , while its mechanical setup remains essentially unchanged. Zontes has introduced a ride-by-wire throttle on its three-cylinder sport bike , which makes throttle response more progressive and improves riding smoothness. The equipment also includes cruise control, useful for constant-speed cruising, and a quickshifter for fast and precise gear shifts. On the aerodynamic front, the motorcycle features integrated winglets in the bodywork, a solution that generate downforce on the front end at high speeds, helping with stability and control. The 699 cc three-cylinder engine is confirmed, producing 95 hp (70 kW) at 11,500 rpm and 74.4 Nm at 8,500 rpm, while the 35 kW (47.6 hp) version remains available for A2 license holders. The chassis is also confirmed , featuring adjustable Marzocchi suspension: the fork is adjustable for preload, compression, and rebound, while the rear monoshock is adjustable for preload and rebound. The seat height is 820 mm from the ground, and the ZT703-RR is equipped with 120/70-17 front and 180/55-17 rear tires. The 6-axis inertial platform works alongside dual-channel cornering ABS, which provides stable braking even on low-grip surfaces, and traction control, which monitors the rear wheel. It is available in two color schemes: Red and Black. Price and availability are expected to be announced at EICMA. signals.title: AUMOVIO expands its range of two-wheeled mobility solutions
signals.summary: The Frankfurt-based company , which specialises in mobility technologies, is bringing its solutions for two-wheelers and powersports vehicles to EICMA 2026. Among the key new products is the MK 120 MAB braking system , designed for three-wheeled scooters, quads, UTVs and side-by-side vehicles. The system incorporates electronic stability control functions, aimed at improving the vehicle’s handling in the most critical situations. Alongside this new product, AUMOVIO is presenting the Motorcycle ABS 2.3 Base and the MiniMAB EVO , braking systems intended for various categories of motorbikes and scooters. For high-end models, radar technologies are also available for adaptive speed control, collision warning and blind-spot monitoring. Rounding off the display are TFT instrument clusters with screens ranging from 4 to 8.8 inches, the Connected Infotainment Box (CIB) for navigation and connectivity, and AMT solutions for automated clutch and gearbox management. signals.title: Ducati Desmo250 MX: the desmodromic engine joins the quarter-litre class
signals.summary: Following on from the Desmo450 MX - already featured in the news section of this website - Ducati is expanding its motocross range with a 250 machine developed for competition : a 44.5 CV desmodromic engine, an aluminium chassis and adjustable electronics. Developed by Alessandro Lupino in the Italian Prestige MX2 championship , the new Desmo250 MX brings a number of technical solutions derived from track experience to the most fiercely contested segment of motocross, starting with the desmodromic valve train. The all-new single-cylinder engine, weighing 24.7 kg, delivers 44.5 CV at 12,500 rpm, with a maximum rev limit of 15,000 rpm. The engine is mated to a 5-speed gearbox with an engagement quickshifter and a Brembo hydraulic clutch. The perimeter frame and aluminium swingarm are derived from the Desmo450 MX, with revised stiffness, whilst the Showa suspension features a specific set-up. The braking system, supplied by Brembo, uses Galfer discs. The declared weight is 103 kg, without fuel. The electronics include customisable engine maps, two-level engine braking and three-level Launch Control. Naturally, Ducati Traction Control is also included, which intervenes based on the actual slip of the rear wheel, modulating power delivery. The Ducati Performance catalogue completes the range with special components and accessories inspired by the factory bike. signals.title: Insta360 Mic: flagship-level audio for everyday contents
signals.summary: Insta360 launched Insta360 Mic , an advanced wireless microphone for content creators that brings flagship-level audio to everyday shooting. Mic is Insta360’s first customizable E-Ink wireless mic with expandable storage , pairing a display creators can personalize with a micro SD slot that lets them decide how they record. A wireless microphone for creators who want more capable audio without stepping up to a flagship, whether they are vlogging daily life, filming weekend sports, traveling, livestreaming, or recording a group conversation. Three voice tone presets, Regular, Rich, and Bright, let creators add brightness or a deeper, fuller sound while keeping the natural character of their voice. Each transmitter runs for up to 13 hours on a single charge. With the charging case, battery life extends to up to 34 hours, enough for back-to-back shoot days without hunting for an outlet. Mic joins the flagship Mic Pro and the entry-level Mic Air to complete Insta360’s wireless microphone lineup.
